CHOSEN — Two doors
The page is the choice. Both storage options side by side with their honest trade-offs, including what each one costs you. White for local, black for Drive.

SIGN-IN DETAIL
Reference for the trust copy. The struck-through grants — see your other Drive files, know your name or email — are the strongest element and get folded into the build.

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference.
A: manifesto, giant type, claim as hero.
B: specimen, the typeset output as hero.
